Quick question for the engineering leaders in here: how long does it take your team to go from a product decision to seeing data that confirms it was right?

For most of the teams we talk to, the answer is "too long."

We built our real-time dashboard feature to close that gap. No data engineering setup. No waiting. Just live analytics your whole team can read.

If you've ever shipped something and had to wait a week to know if it worked, this is for you.
posts.rationale: Opens with a direct question to the target audience, uses conversational tone appropriate for Facebook.

posts.content:
Here's something we hear a lot: "We have the data. We just can't get to it fast enough."

Engineering teams at growth-stage startups are making decisions on week-old numbers because their analytics stack can't keep up with their pace.

Real-time analytics shouldn't be a luxury. It should be the baseline.

That's the product we built. And we'd love to show you how it works.
posts.rationale: Voice-of-customer framing builds empathy, positions real-time analytics as a baseline expectation.

posts.content:
We surveyed 50 engineering leads and found that most of them spend more time maintaining their analytics setup than actually learning from it.

That's backwards.

Your data stack should work for you — not the other way around.

Our platform connects to your data source and gives you live dashboards in minutes. No engineers required. No week-long setup.

Happy to share more if you're curious — just drop a comment.
posts.rationale: Research stat lends credibility, casual CTA in comments fits Facebook's community interaction style.
